errors.text_span: the shortest bar, corresponding to the 0.0 bin, has an approximate height representing 11.2%
errors.evidence: The bar with height 11.2% is not the shortest; the two bars with a height of 3.4% are the shortest.
The tallest bar, with a height of 76.2%, represents the bin for the range 0.8 to 1.0, not a '1.0 bin'.

errors.text_span: three bars of equal height at 3.4%
errors.evidence: The figure shows only two bars with a height of 3.4%, not three.
The two bars at 3.4% correspond to the bins [0.2, 0.4] and [0.4, 0.6]. The bin starting at 0.6 has a height of 5.8%, not 3.4%.

errors.text_span: The bar representing the 0.8 bin has an approximate height of 5.8%.
errors.evidence: This is a completely incorrect mapping. The bar representing the bin starting at 0.8 has a height of 76.2%. The bar with a height of 5.8% corresponds to the bin starting at 0.6.
